title: bem-ls configuration
description: Configuration for the BEM language server and jsx2scss. Values here override editor settings.

naming.description: How class names are split into block, element, modifier and value.

preset.description: classic: block__elem--mod. kv: block__elem--key_value. react: Block-elem_mod_value. custom: your own separators and patterns.

valueSeparator.description: Separator before a modifier value (kv: "_"). Empty disables values.

block.description: Regular expression a block name must match (anchors are added).

element.description: Regular expression an element name must match.

modifier.description: Regular expression a modifier name must match.

value.description: Regular expression a modifier value must match.

invalidName.description: A class doesn't follow the naming convention. Default: warning.

nestedElement.description: An element of an element, like b__e1__e2. Default: info.

modifierWithoutBase.description: b--m on an element without b. Default: warning.

elementOutsideBlock.description: b__e with no ancestor using block b. Default: warning.

multipleBlocksMix.description: One element carries two different blocks. Default: info.

missingInStylesheet.description: A class has no selector in the component's stylesheet. Default: warning.

unusedSelector.description: A stylesheet class no component uses (shown faded). Default: hint.

moduleClassMissing.description: styles.x where the CSS module has no .x. Default: error.

ignore.description: Regular expressions; matching classes are skipped by every rule and by skeleton generation, e.g. "^js-".

stylesheet.description: How components find their stylesheets and how Sass URLs resolve.

lookup.description: Strategies, in order: an imported stylesheet, a sibling with the same name, another stylesheet in the directory, parent directories.

extensions.description: Stylesheet suffixes tried, in order, for sibling and parent lookups.

maxSearchDepth.description: How many parent directories the parent lookup searches.

loadPaths.description: Directories (relative to the root) Sass also searches for @use/@import.

aliases.description: Import prefixes mapped to root-relative directories, e.g. {"@/": "src/"}.

exclude.description: Directory names skipped when indexing the workspace.

globalFallback.description: Resolve variables, mixins and functions that aren't reachable through @use/@import to a global definition anywhere in the workspace (for injected partials).

nesting.description: dom: nest by the JSX tree. bem: one rule per block, nested by class name.

classFunctions.description: Helpers whose arguments are class names.

identifiers.description: Identifiers treated as CSS modules even without an import. Names bound by a stylesheet import are detected automatically.

enabled.description: Suggest missing BEM selectors as ghost text in stylesheets.

diagnosticsDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after a change before checking.

scanOnStartup.description: Index the workspace in the background at startup.
